title: Listen to Remarkable People
primary_theme: Evangelism, craft, and making people remarkable
founder_lessons: Fall in love with products and missions deeply enough to evangelize them authentically.
Do not confuse raw authenticity with quality; craft and editing can help the audience and guest.
Anticipate what customers want rather than only asking them what they need.
Make content, products, and storytelling good enough for selective audiences, not just mass attention.
notable_quotes: Basically, I fall in love with stuff and I go with it.
Obviously I spend 15 hours editing, but I try to make the podcast as clean and entertaining and position my guest as remarkably as possible.
what I love about Digital Nest is that they're giving the kids of farm workers a digital future.
